title: It is between the lines of his last written words, it is petrified on his tombstone under which her four bones are not to be laid
html_source:
Shakespeare’s tombstone in Holy Trinity Church in Stratford-upon-Avon reads:

Good friend for Jesus sake forbeare,
To dig the dust enclosed here.
Blessed be the man that spares these stones,
And cursed be he that moves my bones.
